Title: Search one-way flights for a valid route and today's date
Steps: 1. Select One way 2. Leaving from = DEL 3. Going to = BOM 4. Travel date = today 5. Click Search
Expected result: Results page opens; only DEL to BOM flights are listed; every flight departs on today's date; date field shows today
Why this priority: Core purpose of the feature - if this fails users cannot find any flight

Title: Search for tomorrow's date
Steps: Same as TC01 with tomorrow's date
Expected result: All flights shown depart tomorrow; date field shows tomorrow
Why this priority: Wrong date = user books the wrong flight (money and trust lost)

Title: Search for a date in a later month
Steps: Select a date ~5 weeks ahead (calendar must move to next month), search
Expected result: Calendar moves to the next month; results and date field show the chosen date
Why this priority: Common user journey; calendar month navigation is a frequent source of bugs

Title: Results show only the selected route
Steps: Check origin / destination on every flight card
Expected result: Every card shows DEL as origin and BOM as destination; no other airports
Why this priority: Showing a different route is as bad as no result
Automate?: Yes (automated - when results API is reachable)

Title: Selected route and date are kept on the results page
Steps: Check the search form at the top of the results page and the URL
Expected result: Form still shows DEL, BOM and the chosen date; URL contains from=DEL, to=BOM, depart=<date>
Why this priority: User must be able to see what they searched for and share / reload the link

Title: Past dates cannot be selected
Steps: Open the calendar and try to click yesterday
Expected result: Yesterday (and all earlier days) are disabled; today is enabled
Why this priority: Searching in the past makes no sense and can break the search back end

Title: Maximum future date
Steps: Move the calendar to the last allowed month and pick the last date
Expected result: Last bookable date can be selected; dates after it are disabled
Why this priority: Edge case; airlines publish schedules ~330 days ahead

Title: Search without a destination
Expected result: Error 'Add arrival airport or city' shown; no search is made; field is marked invalid
Why this priority: Without clear validation users get stuck or see confusing results

Title: Search without an origin
Expected result: Error asking for a departure airport; no search is made
Why this priority: Same as TC08

Title: Same origin and destination
Steps: Pick DEL as origin and DEL as destination
Expected result: Not allowed: error message or the same airport cannot be picked twice
Why this priority: Rare user mistake; no money impact if blocked

Title: Swap origin and destination
Expected result: Fields become BOM to DEL
Why this priority: Convenience feature; users can still type the route by hand

Title: Search airport by IATA code
Expected result: Suggestion list shows 'DEL Delhi International Airport' at the top
Why this priority: Users cannot fill in the route without working suggestions
Automate?: Yes (automated - skipped when API blocks bots)

Title: Search airport by city name and partial text
Expected result: BOM is suggested for all spellings (case-insensitive)
Why this priority: Most users type the city name not the code

Title: Unknown or invalid text
Expected result: Friendly 'no results' message; no crash; no script runs
Why this priority: Robustness and basic security (XSS)

Title: No flights available for route/date
Preconditions: Pick a route with no flights
Expected result: Clear 'no flights found' message with a hint to change the search
Why this priority: User is informed but no wrong data is shown

Title: Flight card details
Expected result: Shows airline, departure/arrival time, duration, stops, price
Why this priority: User needs this information to choose a flight

Title: Departure times are in the local time of the origin airport
Steps: Compare a card with the airline's schedule
Expected result: Times match the airline schedule in local time (IST)
Why this priority: Wrong time = missed flight

Title: Search for today late in the evening
Expected result: Only flights that have not departed yet are shown (or a clear message)
Why this priority: Edge case around 'today'

Title: Change the number of adults
Expected result: Results show prices for 2 adults; travellers field shows '2 adults'
Why this priority: Not part of the core route/date requirement but affects price

Title: Results load time
Expected result: Results appear within the agreed time (e.g. < 3 s)
Why this priority: Slow search = users leave

Title: Mobile layout
Expected result: All fields and results are usable; nothing cut off
Why this priority: Large share of travel searches are on mobile

Title: Keyboard and screen reader
Steps: Fill the form and search using only the keyboard
Expected result: All fields reachable with Tab; labels read out; errors announced
Why this priority: Accessibility (WCAG) and legal compliance

Title: Browser back / refresh / shared link
Steps: Refresh the results page, press Back, open the URL in a new browser
Expected result: Same search is shown every time
Why this priority: Users share and bookmark searches

Title: Date format follows the site language
Expected result: Dates are shown in the right local format
Why this priority: Cosmetic; the date itself is still correct
